thread:
sam: rolled v2.4.0 canary. quick FYI — embedded route embed-eu switched to modelx:quant2 in eu-west1 at 13:04 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary progress 0% -> 100% in 8m. details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3219876543 :robot_face:
rachel: saw a tiny synth blip — p95 for embed-kv-warmup jumped 140ms -> 310ms around +3m. not huge user impact but notable.
sam: hmm, only in eu-west1? any cache miss signal?
ops-oncall: kv-miss delta +18% at the same time, and small tail of retryable 502s from prefills. runbook suggests regional pin if synthetic p95 >250ms for >2m.
rachel: agree. prefer regional pinback to fp16 so global traffic keeps rolling. low risk.
smoke-bot: running quick probe now on eu-west1 embed-kv-warmup. ETA ~40s.
sam: executing regional pin: rdctl routes patch --route embed-eu --region eu-west1 --variant modelx:fp16 --note "synth p95 + kv miss spike post-canary"
deploy-bot: route config updated, rolloutid r-2026-09-13-3219.
smoke-bot: results: before pin p95 312ms, after pin p95 125ms. kv-miss delta down to 2%. :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: leaving global rollout paused for 15m observation. adding a followup issue for "quant2 warmup ordering and kv prefetch priority" with traces attached.
sam: logging into release notes: "v2.4.0: temporarily pinned embed-eu in eu-west1 to modelx:fp16 due to synthetic kv-warmup latency spike associated with quant2 warmup ordering. investigation open."
rachel: also adding a monitoring alert for kv-miss heatmap spikes >10% during rollouts.
ops-oncall: marking this thread for 30m retention; will close if no regressions. thanks team. :thumbsup:
